claims.text: The latest stable Pulumi CLI release is v3.263.0, released 2026-09-16 (the comparison table at L134 lists v3.261.0, released 2026-09-02, as of 2026-09-21).
The latest stable Terraform release is v1.16.3, released 2026-09-16 (the comparison table at L135 lists v1.16.1, released 2026-09-02, as of 2026-09-21).
The latest stable AWS CDK release is v2.270.0, released 2026-09-17 (the comparison table at L136 lists v2.268.0, released 2026-09-02, as of 2026-09-21).
The latest stable Azure Bicep release is v0.47.16, released 2026-09-08 (the comparison table at L139 still lists v0.46.1, released 2026-07-30).
The latest stable Kubernetes release is v1.37.0, released 2026-08-26.
The latest stable Crossplane release is v2.4.1, released 2026-09-15 (the comparison table at L142 still lists v2.4.0, released 2026-08-20).
The latest stable OpenTofu release is v1.12.6, released 2026-08-19, as of 2026-09-21.
Version and release-date figures in the tables were checked against each project's GitHub releases on 2026-09-21.
The pricing table reflects published pricing as of September 2026.
env0 has been renamed 'env zero'.
Spacelift's paid plans scale by private worker count rather than seats or resources, with quote-based pricing at the top end.
env zero prices its paid tiers per successful apply or environment.
Pulumi has approximately 25.7k GitHub stars.
Terraform has approximately 49.7k GitHub stars.
AWS CDK has approximately 12.9k GitHub stars.
Azure Bicep has approximately 3.6k GitHub stars.
Kubernetes has approximately 127.9k GitHub stars.
Crossplane has approximately 12.1k GitHub stars.
OpenTofu has approximately 30.2k GitHub stars.
Google Cloud Deployment Manager reached end of support on March 31, 2026.
Google Cloud Deployment Manager will be fully turned down on June 30, 2027.
Google Cloud Infrastructure Manager replaces Google Cloud Deployment Manager.
Pulumi Cloud's Free edition is free forever for one user, with unlimited stacks and projects and 500 workflow minutes per month.
Pulumi Cloud's Essentials plan starts at $40/month, including 40 credits and up to 500 managed resources.
Pulumi Cloud's Pro plan starts at $400/month, including 400 credits and up to 2,000 managed resources.
Pulumi Cloud's Enterprise plan is custom, contract-priced.
HCP Terraform is free for up to 500 managed resources with one concurrent run, then moves to per-resource pricing of roughly $0.10 to $0.99 per resource per month depending on tier.
Self-hosted Terraform Enterprise is available at custom pricing for larger organizations.
The managed-platform pricing figures reflect published pricing checked on 2026-09-21.
By GitHub stars, Kubernetes leads the broader infrastructure ecosystem at roughly 127,900 stars as of 2026-09-21.

Among dedicated IaC tools, Terraform is the most-starred at roughly 49,700 stars, followed by OpenTofu at roughly 30,200, Pulumi at roughly 25,700, AWS CDK at roughly 12,900, and Crossplane at roughly 12,100 (measured 2026-09-21).
Pulumi, OpenTofu, and Crossplane have grown fastest among teams prioritizing general-purpose languages, open governance, or Kubernetes-native infrastructure management, respectively.
Terraform's larger community reflects a decade of first-mover adoption.
Terraform moved to the Business Source License in 2023, and OpenTofu forked from Terraform's last MPL-2.0 release and now operates under Linux Foundation governance.
AWS CDK, CloudFormation, Azure ARM, Azure Bicep, and Google Cloud Infrastructure Manager carry no separate tool fee; you pay only for the cloud resources you provision.
